risk_summary: The disclosure is highly quantified but indicates substantial financial stress, including a $21.3 million net loss, $17.2 million of operating cash use, recurring losses, and dependence on new cash inflows and financing. Debt extinguishment produced a one-time gain, but liquidity and going-concern prospects remain dependent on uncertain exploration monetization, collections, charters, and equity financing. Prior NASDAQ compliance issues further elevate execution and market-access risk.
